entries.document: Wharfedale DIAMOND 12.1 product page (manufacturer web store). Exact model Diamond 12.1.
entries.evidence: Spec table: "Transducer complement | 2-way"; bass driver 5 in (130 mm) PP cone; treble driver 1 in (25 mm) textile dome; bass reflex; recommended amplifier power 20-100 W; nominal impedance 8 ohm. No explicit passive or active statement (amplifier recommendation is not used as evidence).

fieldResults.note: Manufacturer spec table: 2-way, one 5 in bass driver and one 1 in treble driver (exact 12.1).
Page gives only a recommended amplifier power range; not used to infer passive status.

entries.document: ELAC Uni-Fi series sell sheet (manufacturer PDF). Exact model Uni-Fi UB5 bookshelf.
entries.evidence: UB5 spec table: "3-way bass reflex"; tweeter 1 in soft dome; mid-range 4 in aluminum; woofer 5.25 in aluminum; text says the 1 in tweeter and 4 in midrange form one concentric driver; maximum power input 140 W; nominal impedance 4 ohm. No explicit passive or active statement.

fieldResults.note: Sell sheet lists three transducer rows, but the tweeter and midrange are one concentric driver, so the physical count is 2 and the transducer count is 3. The schema does not define which convention applies. Not promoted; owner decision needed.
Sell sheet has no passive or active statement; a maximum power rating alone does not establish passive status.
